messages:
andrew: Heads-up — ResellerAtlas just notified product ops they're planning a short promo (Aug 15–Sep 15) that could drive ~2.5x uplift in EU & US traffic. they quoted ~1.2M extra tokens/day. we need contingency capacity planning.
maria: ugh timing — we have eu-west maintenance the week before. do we have spare reserved GPUs in eu-west? :thinking_face:
liam: quick snapshot: committed reserved = 320 A100 GPU-hours/day (eu-west). avg utilization ~67% last 30d. current spare ~105 GPU-hours/day under normal load.
capacity-bot: forecast update: projected peak gpu_hours/day for reseller-atlas-promo = 820 (+156%). confidence: medium. details: https://internal/forecasts/1845123456
jess: can we spill to dedicated shared pools in us-west and do cross-region routing? it'll raise egress and latency but avoids throttling.
andrew: prefer to avoid cross-region where possible. want to quantify runway if we rely on autoscale + spot backfill vs asking reseller for a temporary commit. cost delta?
samir: ran a quick sim: enable burst capacity up to 3000 GPU-hours/day for 30 days; assume 70% spot fill. incremental monthly cost ≈ $160k (baseline period cost ≈ $260k, burst period ≈ $420k). rough numbers only.
eva: that delta is material. can we get reseller to cover overage or commit to a short-term reserved block? @maria can you escalate in partner call?
maria: yes — i'll ask for a temporary reserved commit or at least 30% overage credit during promo window. will push for revenue-share on extra usage.
liam: infra constraints: autoscaler placement needs a new policy to prefer eu-west racks A1/A2 (low-latency) and avoid racks under maintenance. i'll open a PR.
andrew: include a forced-fallback policy: if eu-west capacity >85% route to eu-central quantized variant (redwood-q4-quant) with ~10% perf delta. document SLOs and expected p95 impact.
jess: also need cache warmup plan. switching traffic to quantized model cold will spike tails. propose pre-populating KV cache for top 5k prefixes before cutover.
samir: i'll run the warmup. command i'll use:
```
python infra/warmup.py --model redwood-q4-quant --region eu-central --prefix-list top5k.json --concurrency 40
```
planning to run at 05:00 UTC day-before promo.
andrew: timeline: maria escalates partner commit today; liam PRs placement + fallback by EOD; samir schedules warmup tomorrow AM; jess and ops on standby for rollback.
maria: added to partner agenda and DM'd reseller contact. :thumbsup:
liam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2931 — includes placement policy + fallback routing. cc @andrew
ops-bot: Incident-prep checklist created: /incidents/templates/reseller-surge.json — assigned to @jess, @samir
jess: i'll test fallback latency on staging and post p95 numbers by 11:30 PT today.
samir: warmup job scheduled 05:00 UTC tomorrow; will post completion status.
andrew: also need a BOE on token-level cost for exec: what's per-1M token unit cost at burst config vs quantized fallback?
liam: BOE: burst config estimate ~ $0.0026 per 1k tokens => $2.60 per 1M tokens. quantized fallback ~ $1.90 per 1M tokens. add ~30% for egress when cross-region.
maria: noted. i'll push partner to cover at least 30% of incremental and confirm by EOD. will update calendar and ops channel.
jess: staging p95 results: quantized fallback = 420ms p95, full model baseline = 280ms p95. all within rollback thresholds.
andrew: perfect. keep updates here if anything diverges. thanks team.
